name: RC-B10-0508/2026 – After § 8 – Am 7
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on media freedom and rule of law in the Czech Republic: threats to the independence of public broadcasters
part_text: 8a. Acknowledges that between the announcement of the Czech Government coalition programme in January 2026 and the first parliamentary reading on reform of the funding system of Czech Television and Czech Radio in October 2026, at least 41 documented public debates covered by both public and commercial media were dedicated to or included the topic of changing the financial model for Czech public broadcasters;
